project.name: surgidoc
project.objective: SurgiDoc: an endoscopy documentation assistant per Architecture Flowchart.png (EndoViT frame description, RAG over TigerCloud, LangGraph orchestration with generator and judge agents using Google AI Studio free models, guardrails, human approval, PDF report, Redis cache, observability). Dataset from Kaggle. Secrets in a local keys txt file. Maintain a decisions MD file consulted before decisions. Test cases for everything.

assumptions.text: Voyage multimodal-3.x free allowance (200M text tokens) is from a third-party page and free trial is 3 RPM / 10K TPM without payment method; Cohere trial limits unverified. Verify before committing.
Gemini free tier may use content for product improvement; acceptable only because data is public.

invariants.text: Whenever work needs TigerCloud (or any service credential: Redis, Google AI Studio, Kaggle, Voyage, Cohere, EndoVIT endpoint), STOP and ask the user in chat to fill the matching keys.txt entries (TIGERCLOUD_SERVICE_URL, TIGERCLOUD_DB_PASSWORD, ...). Never invent values; code must raise MissingKey naming the entry.

decisions.title: Gemini-only LLMs via Google AI Studio
decisions.text: All agent LLM calls (generator, judge) use Gemini free-tier models via Google AI Studio API. No OpenRouter/GPT/Claude. Embedding: Voyage multimodal + Cohere rerank only if free tier verified at implementation time, else gemini-embedding-001.

decisions.title: Data: public only, human approval mandatory
decisions.text: Only public datasets (Kaggle newslab/cholecseg8k via kagglehub, plus public EU/Germany-focused endoscopy surgery text) are used. No real patient data. Every generated report requires human approval; output is a draft, never a diagnosis.

decisions.title: Scope: all layers, production/enterprise grade, Python
decisions.text: Build every layer in Architecture Flowchart.png (RAG, LangGraph generator/judge, guardrails, gateway, human approval, PDF, TigerCloud+Redis, observability, security/governance). Python, LangGraph, pytest, tests for every component. Secrets in git-ignored keys.txt. DECISIONS.md consulted before every decision.

decisions.title: EndoViT runs remotely, not on local CPU
decisions.text: User CPU is weak. EndoViT inference must go through a free hosted option (to be found; none confirmed). Frame-description sits behind an interface so a Gemini-vision fallback is possible.

decisions.title: MIMIC-IV-Note rejected; licence limits on KB sources
decisions.text: MIMIC-IV-Note rejected (credentialed DUA, patient notes, US ICU). ESGE KB papers are CC BY-NC(-ND) and CholecT45/CAMMA CC BY-NC-SA: non-commercial prototype only. 4 of 6 ESGE papers are Cascade guidelines for resource-limited settings, not full ESGE guidelines.

decisions.title: Embeddings: gemini-embedding-001 default, dim 768
decisions.text: Docs (ai.google.dev, 2026-10-26): gemini-embedding-2 is multimodal but aggregates a batch into ONE embedding and has no task_type, so text RAG defaults to gemini-embedding-001 (batch, taskType, we L2-normalize truncated dims). Model/dim configurable; revisit embedding-2 for frame/image search. Voyage/Cohere not used until free limits verified. Tiger Cloud: pg_textsearch BM25 (<@>) + pgvectorscale diskann + RRF k=60.

decisions.title: T03 scope baseline hand-refreshed (user-approved bypass)
decisions.text: T03 base_manifest predated T02A/T02B (Genesis sets it once via ||=; requeue does not refresh), so completion falsely flagged T02's files as out of scope. At the user's explicit instruction (option 2) the stale base_manifest was removed from project.json. T03's real scope was verified from git: only surgidoc/retrieval and tests/test_retrieval.py.

knowledge.text: gh is not installed in this WSL environment; GitHub repo ChandrikaSethumadhavan/surgidoc creation is user-authorized but blocked until gh is installed and authenticated.

knowledge.title: Candidate public sources for KB/datasets
knowledge.text: Images/video (not report text): HyperKvasir (datasets.simula.no/hyper-kvasir, CC-BY 4.0, 58.6GB full; labeled images 3.9GB, segmentation 46MB). Text KB (EU/DE): AWMF/DGVS S3 sedation guideline 021-014 (register.awmf.org PDF, 2023), ESGE guidelines in Endoscopy (Thieme, many open access). Unverified: Kvasir, Cholec80, EndoVis, Kaggle mirrors, licences of each PDF.

knowledge.title: Gemini free-tier models and limits
knowledge.text: ai.google.dev pricing (2026-10-26): free of charge input/output for gemini-2.5-flash, 2.5-flash-lite, 3.6-flash, 3.5-flash-lite, 3.1-flash-lite. Per-model RPM/TPM/RPD are NOT published on the rate-limits page (view in AI Studio); limits are per project, RPD resets midnight Pacific, 429 RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED on breach. Free tier content may be used to improve products: public data only. Gateway: configurable routes+limits, conservative defaults, 429 is ground truth.
